subject: english
question:
Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, then select the option "No error".

If conventional arrangements and/ patterns are made more scarcer, other/ arrangements and patterns will spring up.

options.text: arrangements and patterns will spring up.
patterns are made more scarcer, other

solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4'** i.e. **'Patterns are made more scarcer other'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

The error in the original sentence is the use of the comparative form **"more scarcer."**

The word** "scarcer"** is already a comparative form of the adjective "scarce."

Adding** "more"** **before "scarcer**" creates redundancy. To correct the error, **we remove "more"** and use "scarcer" on its own.

The corrected **sentence maintains** the intended meaning, stating that if conventional arrangements and patterns are made scarcer, other arrangements and patterns will emerge or come into existence.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *If conventional arrangements and patterns are **made scarcer,** other arrangements and patterns will spring up.*
